mapper.select: INSERT INTO `member` SET regDate = NOW(), updateDate = NOW(), provider = #{provider}, providerId = #{providerId}, loginPw = #{loginPw}, `name` = #{name}, email = #{email};
SELECT M.*, MI.data AS extra__data FROM `member` AS M INNER JOIN memberImage AS MI ON M.id = MI.memberId WHERE M.provider = #{provider} AND M.providerId = #{providerId};
SELECT M.*, MI.data AS extra__data FROM `member` INNER JOIN memberImage AS MI ON M.id = MI.memberId WHERE M.loginId = #{loginId}
UPDATE memberImage SET fileName = #{fileName}, data = #{imageBytes} WHERE memberId = #{memberId}
